assessments.reasoning: The supplied survey questionnaires only collect data on hours spent working in paid employment or business activities (such as in question f.38, which asks for hours worked per day in the main job during the reference week). The instrument does not contain any time use module or questions asking respondents how they allocate or spend time across daily activities (such as unpaid care, housework, study, or leisure). As specified by the indicator, questions that only record hours of paid work do not satisfy the criterion.
